# ForgeSpec MCP

> The coordination backbone for multi-agent AI development. MCP Server for Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — provides typed contract validation, SQLite-backed task board management with authority control, and advisory file locking to coordinate work across multiple AI agents. Works with any MCP-compatible client: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, and more.

## Why ForgeSpec?

Multi-agent AI development creates coordination challenges: conflicting file edits, lost context between agents, unstructured workflows, no quality gates, and no way to resume failed tasks. ForgeSpec solves all of these with:

- **Zero infrastructure** — Embedded SQLite database, no external services required
- **Universal compatibility** — Any MCP client (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenClaw)
- **Instant setup** — `npx -y forgespec-mcp@1.5.3`
- **9-phase SDD pipeline** — Enforced confidence thresholds prevent premature transitions
- **Full audit trail & authority** — Every contract, task, grant, revocation, and reservation is logged with immutable history
- **Cross-platform** — Tested on Ubuntu, Windows, macOS with Node 22, 24, 26 (primary Node 24.18.1)
- **Cortex-ready** — Native integration with [Cortex](https://github.com/lleontor705/cortex) for persistent memory and knowledge graph

## Recommended: Pair with Cortex

ForgeSpec manages the **workflow** (contracts, tasks, file locks, authority). [Cortex](https://github.com/lleontor705/cortex) manages the **memory** (observations, knowledge graph, session continuity). Artifacts saved with `type: "cortex"` are persisted to Cortex and linked via knowledge graph. ForgeSpec also works standalone with `type: "openspec"` (filesystem) or `type: "inline"`.

## Quick Start

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/forgespec-mcp): Install via `npx -y forgespec-mcp@1.5.3` or `npm install -g forgespec-mcp@1.5.3`
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/lleontor705/forgespec-mcp): Source code, issues, and contributions
- [Full documentation](https://github.com/lleontor705/forgespec-mcp/blob/master/llms-full.txt): Complete tool reference with parameters and schemas

## SDD Pipeline

9-phase lifecycle with confidence thresholds:

```
init(0.5) → explore(0.5) → propose(0.7) → spec(0.8) → design(0.7) → tasks(0.8) → apply(0.6) → verify(0.9) → archive(0.9)
```

## Tools (30 total)

### Capability & Diagnostic Tools (3)
- `forgespec_capabilities`: Negotiate API/schema versions, capabilities, limits, and mode
- `forgespec_health`: Server health diagnostics, database integrity, system time, active lease counts, and version telemetry
- `tb_audit_log`: Query historical audit trail of authority grants, revocations, and approval decisions

### SDD Contract Tools (5)
- `sdd_validate`: Validate contract against phase schema with confidence check
- `sdd_save`: Validate and persist contract to SQLite
- `sdd_get`: Retrieve contract by ID
- `sdd_list`: List contracts (filter by project/phase)
- `sdd_history`: Phase transition history for a project

### Task Board Tools (19)
- `tb_create_board`: Create task board with optional inline tasks (atomic)
- `tb_add_task`: Add task with priority, spec ref, acceptance criteria, dependencies
- `tb_status`: Board status with tasks grouped by status
- `tb_claim`: Claim task (validates dependencies before assignment)
- `tb_update`: Update status (auto-unblocks dependents on completion)
- `tb_unblocked`: List tasks ready to work on (all dependencies resolved)
- `tb_get`: Full task details by ID
- `tb_list_boards`: List task boards (includes direct-v1 owned/granted boards with actor context)
- `tb_set_dependencies`: Set normalized dependency edges
- `tb_heartbeat`: Renew active attempt lease
- `tb_recover_claims`: Recover expired claims
- `tb_requeue`: Requeue a recovered task
- `tb_approve`: Record immutable approval decision with asserted provenance
- `tb_grant`: Create attenuated, expiring task-authority grant
- `tb_handoff`: Create reference-only attenuated handoff
- `tb_revoke`: Append authority revocation (destructive operation)
- `tb_query`: Query snapshot task pages with signed compound cursors
- `tb_batch_status`: Read bounded board/work-unit status
- `tb_events`: Read authority-event deltas

### File Reservation Tools (3)
- `file_reserve`: Reserve files/globs with TTL (default 15 min; `check_only: true` for dry-run)
- `file_release`: Release file reservations
- `file_renew`: Renew an active direct-v1 file lease

## Configuration

- **Claude Code**: `claude mcp add forgespec --transport stdio -- npx -y forgespec-mcp`
- **Codex CLI**: Add to `~/.codex/config.toml` under `[mcp_servers.forgespec]`
- **Gemini CLI**: Add to `settings.json` under `mcpServers.forgespec`
- **OpenClaw**: Add to `openclaw.json` under `mcp.servers.forgespec`

## Environment Variables

- `FORGESPEC_DIR` (default `~/.forgespec`): Database directory
- `FORGESPEC_DB` (default `~/.forgespec/forgespec.db`): Full database path

## Versioning

Uses conventional commits with automatic semver bumping:
- `fix:` → patch | `feat:` → minor | `feat!:` → major
- Release: `npm run release && git push --follow-tags origin master`
